name: Igneous Rune
description: Igneous Rune is a tiny volcanic moonlet orbiting a gas giant, its diminutive size belying the fury of its geological activity. Tidal forces from its parent planet keep the interior molten, and the surface is a constantly shifting terrain of lava tubes, fissure eruptions, and small but violent supervolcanoes that can reshape entire hemispheres in a matter of weeks. From orbit, the glowing fracture patterns across its dark surface resemble the strokes of an ancient runic script, burning themselves into existence and fading as the lava cools.

The toxic atmosphere is thin and patchy, clinging to the surface in low-lying areas while the higher elevations are essentially vacuum. The low gravity means eruption ejecta can reach escape velocity, creating a sparse ring of cooling debris around the moonlet that glitters like scattered embers. Standing on the surface in the rare stable zones feels precarious—the ground trembles constantly, and new fissures can open without warning, their edges glowing cherry-red as magma rises to fill them.

A pirate syndicate has established a hidden base within one of the larger lava tube networks, using the moonlet's hostile conditions and sensor-disrupting volcanic emissions as cover. The base is surprisingly well-constructed, with heat-shielded habitation modules and a concealed docking bay carved into a dormant tube. Its existence was suspected for years before a patrol vessel detected refined metal signatures during a rare lull in volcanic activity.

The base remains operational despite its discovery, as the volatile surface conditions make any assault prohibitively dangerous. The pirates use the moonlet as a waystation and supply cache, relying on the planet's own hostility as their primary defense. Bounty hunters who have attempted approach report that the volcanic activity seems to intensify whenever vessels enter low orbit—likely coincidence, though the pirates themselves seem to have learned to predict the eruption cycles with uncanny accuracy.
